response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS mix, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), s AS (SELECT mix, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share FROM g), av AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.mix, s.cnt AS count, s.share AS share, s.share - av.avg_share AS above_average FROM s, av WHERE s.share > av.avg_share ORDER BY s.share DESC
